facts: Parties: Brightwater Energy plc (Buyer), Whitlock Industries Ltd (Seller); the Company is Foxley Robotics Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 18 February 2026; Closing is scheduled for 29 April 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 72 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Section 9.5 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $4,950,000. The Purchase Price is $55,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 18 February 2026), either party may terminate.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 18 June 2026.
